description: Recent New Zealand earthquakes from GeoNet (official NZ monitoring, GNS Science), filtered by minimum Modified Mercalli Intensity. MMI 3 ≈ widely felt, 5 ≈ damaging; -1 returns all located quakes. Returns magnitude, depth, locality, felt intensity, and coordinates, newest first. Keyless.

min_mmi.description: Minimum Modified Mercalli Intensity, -1 to 8 (default 3). -1 = all quakes, 3 ≈ widely felt, 5 ≈ damaging. Out-of-range values are clamped.

name: recent_quakes
